description: This file defines a class 'perf_mssql' for performance monitoring and tuning specific to Microsoft SQL Server within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes methods for executing performance queries, explaining SQL execution plans, and retrieving database information.

classes.name: perf_mssql
classes.description: A class extending 'adodb_perf' tailored for MSSQL performance metrics, query explanation, and database diagnostics.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the perf_mssql object with a database connection, adapting SQL syntax based on the connection type.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Provides an execution plan and performance details for a given SQL query, optionally for partial queries.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves information about database tables, including size and index details.

methods.name: sp_who
methods.description: Returns the current number of active sessions in the database.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the MSSQL server, enabling specific trace flags during the process.
